scope: One UTF-8 C# file, direct Roslyn semantic operations and AnalyzeDataFlow, no project loading, restore, MSBuild, Emit, source execution or network.

supported.methods: Synchronous static non-generic block bodies, at most three by-value immutable int/bool/string parameters; no captured or written parameters.
supported.process: Source-ordered terminating if guards followed by one static extern void positional-argument call and final literal return. Calls remain opaque, with argument evaluation order and distinct propagating call failures; no callee behavior, business roles or journey inferred.
supported.decision: Source-ordered if/literal-return guards and final literal return; int/bool inputs only. Pure predicates use !, &&, || and built-in comparisons between a parameter and constant. Pairwise disjoint rule predicates are proven on exact finite Int32 boundary cells and booleans; overlap, parameter-to-parameter or uncertain domains are rejected.
supported.expressions: Semantic constants/nameof, parameter reads, built-in ! and &&/|| and equality/order comparisons, string.Length with propagating null failures, identity conversions and string null constants. Operator overloads and user conversions are unsupported.
supported.exceptions: Actual core-library ArgumentNullException and ArgumentException constructors with explicit positional scalar arguments. Preserve constructor symbol, arguments, throw span and exception type.
supported.source: Original byte SHA-256 and caller-provided 40-hex commit, basename unitPath, physical half-open UTF-16 spans with 1-based coordinates. Git revision ownership is not verified by this offline file command.

unsupportedDisposition: Per-method partial diagnostics and no approximate candidate; unaffected supported neighbors survive. Syntax errors, executable contexts outside method bodies and conditional compilation make file coverage partial. An inverted executable-region census accepts MethodDeclaration ownership and compile-time-only attribute arguments, parameter defaults, enum values and const-field initializers; other blocks, arrows, initializers, constructor/primary-constructor base arguments and global statements make coverage partial. This includes properties/indexers, operators/conversions, accessors, constructors/destructors and field/event/property initialization without enumerating each owner type. Omitted member bodies do not inflate unsupportedMethods, which counts only MethodDeclaration bodies. Full means the supported intra-method recipe, never external behavior or whole-program semantics.
safety: Reject unsafe/traversing/symlink paths, malformed identities, invalid UTF-8, directories and exceeded resource limits. Stage output atomically; reject source overwrite. Deterministic canonical property/array order, UTF-8 without output BOM, LF terminator, no timestamps or machine paths.
privacy: Entire candidate is candidate-content, including symbols, literals and raw predicates. Downstream must require explicit content-profile authorization; merely removing rawPredicate is insufficient.
claims: UNREVIEWED, executable=false; no authored BPMN/DMN, FEEL evaluation, business approval, deployed service or runtime equivalence claim.
oracle: fixtures/candidates/oracle.json freezes expected process/decision observations before implementation from the approved design contract. Test-only candidate interpreter checks those independent expectations; it is not shipped as a candidate execution facility.
knownLimitations: No target SDK/project/reference-closure resolution beyond the installed core-library metadata
No protection against hostile concurrent filesystem replacement between path validation and I/O
